name: Buttondown
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For Buttondown, send Markdown newsletters from a small list with archives and simple automations. The hard boundary is excellent deliverability, hosted simplicity, integrations, and creator-friendly support, plus deliverability, growth network, and integrations.
